quote: The tasks we experimented with are summarization and question answering (i.e., the text generation tasks in HELM)

Our goal is to address the costs associated with evaluating model outputs in text generation ... We focus on comparative evaluation of models. Given two text generation models ... We experiment on summarization and question answering tasks.

We focus on comparative evaluation of models. Given two text generation models, we wish to evaluate which one is stronger with respect to a given generation task, based on preference labels of an oracle over the model outputs.

quote: The metric scores in HELM serve as the ground-truth data, such that the preference label of an example is the model with a higher score for this example (or a tie if scores are equal).
